findings.description: Applies 1D Euler-Bernoulli cantilever beam formula delta = (F*x^2*(3L-x))/(6EI) to mesh nodes and returns hardcoded residual constants (energyNorm: 1.42e-4, maxResidualError: 8.5e-7).
findings.impact: Misrepresents an analytical 1D beam equation as a 3D finite element matrix solver.
findings.recommendation: Deprecate PATCH-016 structuralFem.ts in favor of src/engine/fem/core/GlobalAssemblyEngine.ts.

findings.description: Recovers nodal stress via heuristic formula: stress = Math.sqrt(ux*ux + uy*uy + uz*uz) * E * 0.005 instead of full tensor strain-displacement B-matrix recovery.
findings.impact: Calculates approximate stress proportional to displacement magnitude rather than true gradient tensor.
findings.recommendation: Bind FieldRecoveryEngine.ts (which computes genuine B*u and C*epsilon) into FemVerificationPipeline.

findings.description: Mentions 'fake quantum hydrodynamics equation EQ-FAKE-999' as an adversarial injection scenario to verify that bogus claims are rejected.
findings.impact: Confirms quantum mechanics is strictly an adversarial test artifact, not a production feature.
